svg.title: Issue 6 — Page 1 — Panel 1: Luma briefing — anomaly map blooms over wall-cavity camp
svg.desc: 28mm establishing wide. Wall-cavity camp interior. Luma center, hand into a 3D city wireframe map with six pulsing anomaly nodes and convergence lines. Squad arrayed. Cool blue-violet dominant + warm floorboard leak. Issue 6 opens.
svg.text: Six anomalies in a twelve-block radius.
I've been cataloging them since we arrived.
